sources.title: Uranium bioprecipitation mediated by yeasts utilizing organic phosphorus substrates
sources.accepted_scope: Only explicitly source-assigned K. lactis G2P/1 mM U growth precipitates, with phase/control limits.
sources.text_coverage: 35-page accepted manuscript, all 800 web-parser lines 0–799 retained. Local full PDF acquisition returned 403 on legitimate Dundee routes. Text is a derived snapshot, not PDF bytes.
sources.inspection: Complete manuscript text; all four original publisher figures visually checked, all five complete published HTML tables checked. Methods printed pp6–11, Results pp12–16, Discussion pp17–19; Tables pp26–31 and captions pp32–34.
sources.supplements: No supplement was announced in the inspected accepted manuscript or publisher landing page. This is a bounded inventory, not proof of worldwide absence.
sources.version_notes: Accepted-manuscript Tables 2 and 4 repeat a 0.2 mM PyA heading; published tables give the final 1 mM heading. Do not preserve that resolved manuscript header typo as an unresolved final-source conflict. Publisher tables preferred.
sources.terms: Accepted manuscript and publisher graphics/tables remain external; no copyrighted primary full text committed.

sources.title: Uranium phosphate biomineralization by fungi
sources.inspection: Complete 12-page original read; all Figures 1–6 and Tables 1–2 viewed. Pages 2067/2071 and Figure 5 explicitly discuss nearly identical uranyl-phosphate diffraction patterns.
sources.accepted_scope: Context-only analytical limitation, not definitive confirmation of the 2016 product or a second phase-specific recovery demonstration.
sources.supplements: No supplement announced in the inspected complete original; bounded statement.
sources.terms: Original retained outside Git; copyright remains with source.

sources.terms: List declares CC BY-SA 3.0; original remains external.

sources.identity: Doubled ideal formula K2(UO2)2(PO4)2·6H2O; meta-autunite-group species.
sources.terms: Version 1, ©2001–2005 Mineral Data Publishing; all rights reserved; original outside Git.

sources.limit: No independent authentication of source culture IFO1267; species ID is not a strain ID.

evidence_and_limits.claim: 30 mM G2P replaces KH2PO4, 1 mM uranyl nitrate, 100 mL in 250-mL flasks, 30 C, 180 rpm, darkness, 120 h.
evidence_and_limits.limit: Two preceding 48-h cultivation steps; source calls second medium sucrose- and P-free while standard recipe lists dextrose. No silent carbon-recipe repair.

evidence_and_limits.claim: K. lactis growth-associated precipitates and mixed-phase XRD assignment.
evidence_and_limits.limit: Post-growth 48-h exposure arm is distinct. Table5 merged XRD row does not justify transferring assignment to every dose/P substrate; Figure3 explicitly selects 1 mM/G2P growth.

evidence_and_limits.locator: Figure3b; Table5; Liang2015 pp2067/2071 and Figure5
evidence_and_limits.claim: Source labels meta-ankoleite with chernikovite, bassetite and uramphite.
evidence_and_limits.limit: No refined phase fraction, direct hydration or interlayer characterization. Selected EDX table lists C,O,Al,P,S,U without K/Fe. Exact potassium mineral or iron phase is not independently established.

evidence_and_limits.claim: No-P and uninoculated controls specified; absence of significant abiotic precipitation qualitative; endpoint pH5.5 versus7.0 uninoculated; biomass tolerance index75%.
evidence_and_limits.limit: No numeric precipitation threshold/matched sterile XRD; 75% is biomass relative to uranium-free G2P control, not mineral/U yield. Phosphatase mechanism inferred without intervention/genetic assay.

evidence_and_limits.claim: Yeast-associated uranium phosphate precipitation in a laboratory culture.
evidence_and_limits.limit: No purified meta-ankoleite, mineral-specific balance, isolated recovery, long-term retention or industrial deployment demonstrated.

notices_and_conflicts.queries: Exact DOI correction/retraction and phase-conflict searches included in query-log; first returned sets on 2026-10-14.
notices_and_conflicts.crossref: Live 2016 DOI metadata has no update-to and empty relation.
notices_and_conflicts.result: No matched corrective notice located in this bounded search; not a general absence assertion. Intrinsic phase/recipe/control limitations retained.

deferrals.reason: Liang2016 assigns it in two mixed traces, but selected K. lactis EDX lacks Fe and diffraction overlaps. Require direct phase/cation evidence before separate owner; not admitted by name alone.
